title: Grateful Dead Live at Long Beach Arena on 1972-12-15
source: Source: Soundboard > Master-Reel > Reel (1st gen) > DAT

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a solid 1972 show with smoking China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Box of Rain and a superb Play‑in‑the‑Band jam.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a strong early‑’70s Dead performance – fans point out the sweet China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider segue, a beautiful Box of Rain, a psychedelic Play‑in‑the‑Band stretch and an inspiring Truckin jam. The Sirmick transfer is generally clear and well balanced (a soundboard source), with only minor quirks noted by a few listeners.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise both the musical performance and the transfer quality; only one low‑key comment about mis‑numbered files, so the combined show (70%) + recording (30%) rating lands in the strong‑plus range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced; a few reviewers note minor imperfections but overall a solid transfer with good fidelity to the original soundboard mix.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers highlight a smooth flow with sweet segues, psychedelic jams and tight transitions that keep the momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his “wha‑wha” guitar work and overall strong playing throughout the set.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith's keyboards are noted as being right in the mix, adding depth to the jams.
band_member_comments.Drums: Typical 1972 drum heaviness is tamed here; reviewers describe a balanced drum presence.
